case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.511 OF 2011; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.2345 OF 2011
summary: Conviction under IPC s.302 with s.34 and s.201; Arms Act convictions; eyewitness testimony (PW-2) of blood-stained accused fleeing scene; threats to witness; delay in reporting explained by fear; hostile witnesses reexamined; autopsy confirming gunshot death; High Court erred in doubting testimony without reason; standard: proof beyond reasonable doubt; circumstantial evidence chain intact; murder motive established via financial dispute; enmity referenced; appeal allowed restoring Trial Court conviction.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court conviction and sentence restored.
